power.note: Predeclared 2026-11-03 before any game (board row 5; Jerry: 'ok lets try it'). Candidate planner_finish_next = served planner_offer_accept that, at >= 8 own points (hidden VP cards included), scores each candidate first action (builds, bank trades, development purchase, end turn) by the chance of winning on its next turn: short continuations (depth 3, 32 nodes per candidate) then 128 fixed dice samples of the next four rolls (own production, robber tile blocked, 7 halves a hand over 7), checking whether the hand plus bank trades pays for cities/settlements on legal spots to reach 10; development purchase counts a VP with probability 5/25. Overrides the served move only when the chance is >= .05 higher. Motivation: loss attribution (runs/loss-attribution-offer-accept-*) shows 78% of losses vs Tactical/mixed are 2nd place within 1-2 points; the older same-turn finish search measured +1 to +3 pp (finish-powered-dev-v2). Control served planner_offer_accept. Standard screen: observed paired lift >= +.05 on tactical, mixed and self, 128 seeds per table, fresh seeds 2570000/2571000/2572000. Constants fixed before any game; a fail parks the arm.
